title: The Lean Week

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: A house keeps its days in loaves pushed along a shelf and a space at the end nobody will name. A boy keeps his in days nobody will speak. The two figures sit side by side and do not agree, and nobody makes them agree, because a week that has been counted is a week that can be borne.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the rack-end, Low Kiln

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a seventy-eight-to-eighty-four-day-old body carried everywhere; the old life colours the noticing (a figure read aloud that is not the figure paid, a chart closed over a thing left lying, the order of the hand to the record before the person) without a present-tense Chicago break or a \memory{} tag --- the old life stays offstage --- and there is no departure from his eyes, no Court, Waiting Room or collector interior

scenes.title: Seventy-Eight
scenes.synopsis: One dated entry, Day 78, Silt 19, Ninthday, morning to dusk in the mud of the Clay Yard, at the drying racks and the yard well, and under the Vail kiln-house roof. Opens without recap in the brown skin the mud has set into, faithful to a thing gone; the yard goes around the clean dark line, the new finer grey and the space under the lowest rack with a broom and a glance and no figure spoken, and Sella gives the broom its instruction before anybody (T009/T013/T092, T031, T058/T079). The boy, seventy-eight days old and carried at the half-pace, keeps the count exactly against the house's bad arithmetic in loaves, glances and a space nobody names (T071/T072, T077). The four objects from the week before --- a half-beat delay, a green sliver rubbed with a thumb, a warm loaf into a pocket with no slate, an unfinished sentence --- are carried into the week on separate places, none joined and none spent; a small foundling in cast-offs is glimpsed once more as a silent shape who turns his head a half-beat late toward a pot and rubs the sliver, no secret passing and no betrayal paid (T033/T034). The child's cold foot from below the sill is still the cold to one woman and weather to the yard, carried unnamed and uncured (T093). One brown-edged crust lies stiff in the fold with the empty place beside it unnamed and no third comes (T086/T060). Changes: the lean week opens with the count at seventy-eight unspent and the watcher held as a shape in the file, not a cause. Advances T071/T072, T077, T033/T034, T058/T079, T009/T013/T092, T031, T093, T086/T060, T065/T088. Withheld: no figure spoken, no second sale, no accident of the board, no name or cure for the cold foot, no seventh hearing, no ending.

scenes.title: A Thinner Crowd
scenes.synopsis: One dated entry, Day 79, Silt 20, Tenthday, Account-day, morning to afternoon at the Cross, in the moot-post's finger's width of shade, and down the road at the Fishstairs. Berr Clay comes to the block with the red wool cord folded under his coat and green of tasted glaze at one corner of his mouth, wipes his thumb twice before touching nothing, and reads one in twelve over a crowd made thinner by the flood and the lean week; he takes himself out of his own sentence and goes off believing he has done a kindness (T015, T041, T047, T077). The true subtraction goes over the basket unspoken and the printed figure and the true one lie on trays that do not touch; a figure read aloud is not the figure paid (T077, T072). The bell goes four, four and a gap and nobody crosses himself (T078); the soft-cuffed clerk still sits at the Fishstairs for a measure nobody called, hand to slate before eyes to stalls, filed apart from Marra, the Drawing collector and the Court-table clerk (T090, T080). Mira works the eels under the north bridge and answers a question with her own answer; when a figure is named her thumb goes to the grey cord, showing the second twisted twice beneath it, neither knot counted, her board beside Orra's without touching (T025/T059, T024). Changes: the district's arithmetic is seen to count fewer bodies after the water, and the printed figure stays unchallenged over a thinner crowd. Advances T015/T041/T047/T077, T090/T080, T078, T072, T025/T059/T024, T084, T071/T072. Withheld: no one in three spoken, no box opened, no slate changed, no knot counted, no sixth sighting of the neat dark hand, no ending.

scenes.title: Two Records in One Room
scenes.synopsis: One dated entry, Day 80, Silt 21, Firstday, midday three doors down in House Silt and back under the Vail roof at dusk. Sella sets the basket just inside the finger's-width-open door at the edge of the light and away from every place a slate might lie, opens no slate and turns no errand into a walk to Slate Row (T058, T081). The round pewter tin above the abandoned board-bed keeps its pale fold at its seam and thumb-bright rub, unopened; the fold of grey wool below holds only the hollow where the small pale river stone once lay, and nobody says either is gone (T089, T074, T086). Alda Reed comes short with soap-and-milk gone cold under river silt and lye sour under the soap, lays her birth-slates writing-down before she turns to the fold, presses it too long, crosses two fingers at the red edge of the birth-flower without knowing it and covers the sign with the date she gave Dessa --- now forty mornings dead --- says warm and breathing, exact and not true, and touches the little tin in her bodice without opening it (T007, T008, T073). Her sixth narrow slate stays turned face-down toward a floorboard in a house the boy cannot name; the hidden record stands at six pages, all unread. Do not write a seventh page and do not pay T023 again. Changes: two private records in two materials stand unread in one room, and a third board standing beside a knot-string upriver is not read either. Advances T089/T074, T023 (carried, not repaid), T059/T025/T024, T007/T008/T073, T081, T058, T086, T071/T072. Withheld: no name or number from Dessa, no tin opened, no recognition, no seventh page, no bank errand, no ending.

scenes.title: The Dust Comes Back Again
scenes.synopsis: One dated entry, Day 81, Silt 22, Secondday, before light through midday in the Clay Yard, at the Vail wheel-shed and the room off it (not entered), and at the drying racks. Jorra Vail comes through the finger's-width-open door with fine grey slate dust worked into both forearms past the bend of his little finger, not the bone-coloured slip of the wheel; men came in since first light and he gives the house no name for them (T035). The broken birth-slates stay under the lowest rack, gone around and entered by nobody (T031). He speaks to the wheel before anyone --- it does not care whose hands, only if they are steady --- tells a pot it will do, knows the full note of a Vail pot before it leaves the wheel and will not say so before a kiln-master, and puts his bent finger to the damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence so the end of her instruction arrives at the pot and the household straightens around his silence (T035, T061). He does not say the back room is cold and does not look toward the bed or the basket; he's not Vail stays sealed and the promise of the foundling's name to the men who burn slates is neither given nor withdrawn (T057, T084). The boy keeps dusty forearms and clean bone-coloured ones on one tray and asks neither which slate was broken nor whether it was a birth-slate. Tarn's knife is on its sill and his broom goes over the collector's road without turning (T036, T076). Changes: the room the house does not enter puts its dust into the yard again and the one uncheckable entry under the roof presses toward its end. Advances T035/T031, T057/T084, T061/T082, T036/T076, T009, T071/T072. Withheld: no back room entered, no men named, no slate counted, no name given, no calling of the loan, no ending.

scenes.title: Six Counted
scenes.synopsis: One dated entry, Day 82, Silt 23, Thirdday, before light through dusk in the Clay Yard and under the Vail kiln-house roof. Tarn sets the small bench knife on its sill before the light and tells the empty yard where it is, six years standing in a mark worn almost flat by his thumb and the seventh nearly gone and still held, the one entry in this house the house cannot check; he tells the kindling Six counted. The next I don't count (T036). The seventh year is close enough that something must give at the end of it, but the end is not written here and he goes on holding it as a man holds a breath he has decided not to spend. He agrees so entirely with the ones who want the thaw early and the ones who want it late that no argument can find a foot, and keeps wanting the late one because it puts off the paying, though the paying has stood in the ruts all week. Ash is worked into the creases of his knuckles in the colour of the clean dark line and no scrubbing lifts it; the pale clip-ring at his left wrist holds what light there is. His broom goes over the road a house sends a man down when it wants a collector without once turning along it, and when a vessel gives its note past the door his head does not turn and he does not name the sound, and the boy does not call it a seventh hearing (T009, T061, T076). Changes: the loan that can hear presses closer to its calling while the two silences under one roof keep their equality without a word. Advances T036, T076, T009, T061/T082, T071/T072. Withheld: no seventh year spent, no loan called, no accident of the board, no sound named in Grathic, no ending.

scenes.title: The Thaw That Was
scenes.synopsis: One dated entry, Day 83, Silt 24, Fourthday, morning to dusk at the plank walk downriver at the Weir, the Fishstairs below the north bridge, and back under the Vail roof. Word comes that the weak board in the plank walk is gone or was trodden flat by the flood and nobody has been down to see which; no accident is made of it, and the boy sets the gone board beside the missing Fishstairs step and the hairlines that stopped short of the edge (T083). The honeyed ice, the hairlines and the early Singing Sill note are spoken of now only in the past tense, as the thaw that was --- a thing said after the fact treated as a thing said before it (T085, T092). The steps have come back four, four and a landing a hand's breadth out of line that a whole market walks over carefully without making a fall of it, and the soft-cuffed clerk still sits at the landing for a measure nobody called (T083, T090, T080). Mira works the eels below the bridge and answers a question with her own answer, moving eel-bones while deciding, her thumb to the grey cord when a figure is named and the second twisted twice beneath it shown with neither knot counted (T025/T059). Changes: the month's remaining danger is renamed into a past nobody owns, while the out-of-line step and the gone board stay exactly as they are, entered by nobody. Advances T083/T085/T092, T090/T080, T025/T059, T078, T071/T072. Withheld: no accident of the board, no fall made of the step, no knot counted, no opening, no ending.

scenes.title: What Another Man Says of a Shut Room
scenes.synopsis: One dated entry, Day 84, Silt 25, Fifthday, morning at the yard well and through dusk under the Vail kiln-house roof. A second man come downriver from Greybank, road-mud on his boots and the salt-and-hot-clay smell of the east road on him, repeats at the bucket-round the saying about a counting room shut during the last war with the damper closed and the men inside dead of the breath; the yard takes it as an old curiosity with a date, and Sella tells the fire it is the thaw. The boy files the second telling on the same tray as the first, beside the told bell, the heard bell and the kiln's own missing breath, and writes no cause across any of them; he does not let the second telling join the first to any kiln in Low Kiln (T065, T078, T061). One brown-edged crust lies stiff in the fold with the empty place beside it still unnamed, carried through another week without a name (T086/T060). The new finer grey lies beside the old clean dark line and is not swept, called thaw; the carried fire keeps four, four and a gap under blind ash and the back of a broken pot with its payer still unnamed (T092/T013, T088). The child's cold foot below the sill is still the cold to the woman who wrapped it and weather to the yard (T093). At dusk Sella sets him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without looking at his face and leaves the thread at his mouth frozen and unwiped; the door stands a finger's width open with the river's note through the gap and the fire's gap through the floor kept apart. His hand outside the wool goes up an inch toward the water and comes down, and the count crosses into Silt 26 unspent (T058, T086, T071/T072). Changes: the lean week ends having changed nothing but the count and the private file, which has gained a second telling of the shut room held on its own tray. Advances T065, T086/T060, T093, T061/T082, T092/T013, T088, T071/T072, T058. Withheld: no joining of the two tellings to the kiln, no cause, no seventh hearing, no sixth sighting of the neat dark hand, no name for the cold foot or the empty place, no ending.
